scope: Tony Stark main path from Iron Man (1968) #1 through the existing modern Italian route; Tales of Suspense remains pre-series context.

guardrails.start: Mandatory route begins with Iron Man (1968) #1. Tales of Suspense #39 and Iron Man & Sub-Mariner #1 are pre-series context, not mandatory step 1.
guardrails.firstPublication: Primary physical steps use ComicsBox first official Italian publication; later collections are alternatives.
guardrails.storyLevel: Same-USA-issue backups are audited independently. A later reprint may cover only part of a physical reading step.
guardrails.join: Classic audit stops at Iron Man vol.1 #306; the preserved Marvel Italia tail begins with Iron Man vol.1 #307 in Iron Man e i Vendicatori #1.
guardrails.reusedPhysicalIssues: Repeated narrative uses of the same Italian publication have unique route IDs but one shared physicalId, so ownership is counted once and read state remains path-step-specific.
guardrails.reprintOnly: Iron Man (1968) #76 is a reprint of Iron Man #9 and is excluded from the mandatory narrative spine; it must not create a second reading requirement for the same story.
guardrails.seriesTableBoundaryOverride: Iron Man (1968) #183 remains without an official Italian publication in the audited source. SUPEROICLA_488 contains #179-182; a nested-table boundary artifact must not carry that link into #183.
guardrails.storyFeatureIdentity: Classic Iron Man coverage uses source-USA-issue plus a title-independent ComicsBox story fingerprint. Retitled reprints match; separate backups/features from the same USA issue remain distinct.
guardrails.splitPrimaryFeatures: Iron Man (1968) #178 contains two story features with different first official Italian publications. The route segments the surrounding collected volume path-locally and inserts Super Eroi Classic #475 for the missing feature while reusing physicalId for repeated segments of the same owned book.
